note: Pinned public corpora for parser validation. The SHAs are load-bearing:
an unpinned clone makes `0 leaks across 6,019 events` meaningless, because
the next run measures a different corpus. Both repos are live and move.
Deliberately NOT npm devDependencies, and not vendored:
- claude-code-log is a Python/PyPI project with no package.json, so npm
cannot install it even from git.
- claude-code-sessions is `private: true`; its package.json exists only to
run Prettier on the repo's posts.
- Both names on npm resolve to unrelated projects by other maintainers.
- It is 26 MB of test *data* with no importable surface.
To re-pin after reviewing upstream changes: scripts/verify-corpus.sh --update
Detector results are part of the baseline, not a manual step: a path-dedup fix
moved editCount 1155 -> 791 across all corpora and nobody noticed until asked
whether the corpus had been re-run. Note verifiedEditCount is 0 here because
every pinned project is cold — the gate does not exercise verification end to end.
verifiedEditCount was 0 while confirmation required the verdict to vary — which
confirmed nothing, because 111 of 127 verdict-bearing results come from pipelines
whose exit status belongs to `tail`. Behavioural confirmation (ran after an edit,
twice) made the pinned corpus warm, so the gate now exercises verification too.
